A hidden '''data cache''' was located on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. The encryption key to it was hidden in an ornate golden locket. The cache contained historical records about the royal family of Onderon that the government was more than happy to pay for.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Hidden in the Jungle}}</ref>
